messages.subject: D-RUG's Back in Person, and R For Absolute Beginners is Next Week!
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

We will be meeting this Thursday (9/25) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

Next week Wes will be running a mini-workshop for getting started in R:

Been putting off writing your first line of R code? Coming back to R after a long time away? Feeling intimidated by all the technical jargon? This mini-workshop is for you! Come walk step by step through the very basics of R and learn some best practices along the way. At the end we'll introduce you to additional resources where you can learn even more. We can't wait to see you there!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
